title: User registration
description: Users shall be able to register a new account using a unique email address and password.

title: Login with valid credentials
description: Users shall be able to log in to the system using a valid registered email address and password.

title: Invalid login handling
description: The system shall reject login attempts made with an invalid username or password and display a clear error message.

title: Password reset
description: Users shall be able to reset their password using their registered email address.

title: Email verification
description: New accounts shall require email verification before the user is granted full access.

title: Account lockout
description: The system shall lock a user account after five consecutive failed login attempts.

title: Session timeout
description: User sessions shall automatically expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.

title: Password complexity
description: Passwords shall meet minimum complexity requirements including length and character variety.

title: Profile update
description: Users shall be able to update their profile information such as display name and contact details.

title: Role-based access control
description: The system shall restrict access to administrative features based on the user's assigned role.

title: Duplicate registration prevention
description: The system shall prevent registration of a new account using an email address that is already in use.

title: Logout
description: Users shall be able to log out of the system, immediately terminating their active session.

title: Two-factor authentication
description: The system shall support optional two-factor authentication for users who want enhanced account security.

title: Account recovery via security questions
description: Users shall be able to recover access to their account by answering pre-configured security questions when email access is unavailable.

title: Authentication audit logging
description: The system shall maintain an audit log of authentication-related events, including logins, logouts, and failed attempts.
